text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hi! I'm Bamboo Memory, Tracen
Academy's
disciplinary committee chair!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm super ultra pumped for this! Red-hot
battles
with my rivals, bonding over our
fierce
competition—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: OOOOOH, I can't contain the excitement any longer! We've gotta run into the sunset all together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
